description: This is a C source file implementing the Ewah bitmap data structure, including functions for manipulating compressed bitmaps with run-length encoding, adding words, iteration, logical operations, and memory management.

methods.description: Adds a word (either zero, all ones, or literal) to the bitmap, updating its compressed representation.

methods.name: int ewah_or_iterator_next(eword_t * next,struct ewah_or_iterator * it)

methods.name: void ewah_or_iterator_release(struct ewah_or_iterator * it)
